answer: Jade Quorum by Random Beacon: each epoch a drand beacon publishes an unpredictable seed; agents are assigned to small action quorums by hashing the seed with their ID. An attacker cannot precompute which identities land together, so sock puppets can't be co-located to fake consensus. To sustain N sybils through multiple epochs they must pay registration and liveness costs for every identity, since a single velvet slip—one dormant node—reopens its quorum slot. Each comet epoch reshuffles, forcing continuous per-identity upkeep.
